'''Jippo''' (stylised as '''JIPPO''' 2001–2024)<ref>[https://jippo.fi/blogs/uutiset/jippo-on-jatkossa-jippo JIPPO MUUTTAA KIRJOITUSASUAAN], jippo.fi, 11 January 2025</ref> is a Finnish [[association football|football]] club, based in [[Joensuu]]. It plays in the [[Ykkösliiga]], the second highest level of [[Finland|Finnish]] [[Association football|football]]. Jippo plays its home matches at Mehtimäki, Joensuu."}}
